Name: Harvest Moon TV Variety Channel
Author: AirynS
Description:
Livin' Off the Land and the Fortune Teller are great and all, but doesn't your farmer ever like to just relax and watch something for fun? Harvest Moon TV Variety Channel adds a new daily channel with 22 new TV shows from Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town and Story of Seasons!

Spanning across a range of genres, from murder mystery to travel documentary, romantic comedy to thriller, cooking competition to kids' cartoon, the variety channel has something for everyone and 3-4 shows each day! Some shows will even give you a small buff from the tips you'll pick up! Be careful not to miss an episode though - the show goes on without you and although shows will re-run once they've finished, you may be waiting some time until then.

If you're lucky, you may also see the Goddess's Game Show, a secret channel that can be seen at random. Play Rock-Paper-Scissors or Higher-Or-Lower with the Harvest Goddess on consecutive days to win big prizes if you can keep up your win streak! If you lose a round or forget to play, your win streak will be reset and you'll get your prize in the mail the next day.

[size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]First ensure that all required framework mods are installed, then simply extract the "TV Shopping Network" folder from the zip and drop it into your Mods folder.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]
TV Shopping Network requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41844?]BroadcastAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9296]Esca's Modding Plugins[/url].

This is a companion mod to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45538]TV Shopping Network [/url]and is recommended to be used alongside it! [/color]

[b][size=5]CONFIGURATION[/size]
[/b]Harvest Moon TV Variety Channel has one config option, "Writing Style". For TV shows that are present in both Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town and Story of Seasons: Friends of Mineral Town, this config can be changed between "Story of Seasons" (the default setting) to use the newer SoS translation or "Harvest Moon" to use the original HM translation.

[b][size=5]TRANSLATIONS[/size][/b]
Translations are welcome as long as only the translated i18n file is uploaded and no AI is used in the process of translating.

[b][size=5]CREDITS[/size][/b]
[size=3]The original dialogue for these shows is from Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town, Story of Seasons: Friends of Mineral Town, and Story of Seasons. Artwork for all shows is drawn by hand based on the TV art from the respective games.[/size]
